events.title: LUCC Intro to Rivers
events.description: Intro to Rivers – Halton Session 🛶 This session is aimed at new LUCC members who are ready to start getting into river paddling and learn the basics. We’ll be paddling the River Lune at Halton , starting from our boathouse. The session will introduce you to paddling on a river, including basic river skills, and building confidence in an outdoor environment. You don't need to be an expert — this session is designed to help you make the step from pool sessions onto the river. 🎒 Please bring Swimwear A thermal layer to wear under your wetsuit — synthetic material only, no cotton Shoes that can get wet — old trainers are ideal. No Crocs or flip-flops Spare clothes and a towel — bring warm clothes! Food and drink — snacks can go in someone's dry bag or BA. If you need to borrow any of the above kit, just message someone from the club and we’ll see what we can sort out. 🚗 Transport You will either be assigned a driver or can make your own way to the boathouse. If you're travelling from campus, let us know so we can try to arrange a lift where possible. ⚠️ Cancellations Please give at least 24 hours' notice if you can no longer attend a trip. Otherwise, you may still be required to contribute towards the fuel cost for the car you were assigned to.

events.title: Canoe Taster Session 11/10/26 15:45
events.description: Interested in exploring the lovely rivers of the surrounding countryside? Or an adrenaline junkie yearning for some rapids? Or maybe you want to try a weird new sport where you pass and shoot a water polo ball while in a kayak. Whether you've never sat in a kayak or have done loads of kayaking before, we would love you to come down and give our sport a try. Take part in this FREE taster session where you can try out canoeing in a safe space and see if it might be something you want to continue this year. You must have the free temporary expression of interest membership in order to be able to sign up. Remember to bring some clothes you don't mind getting soggy. We ask you to have a shirt and shorts on (feel free to wear a swimming costume underneath, etc). A towel and a change of clothes are also advisable! Be at the sports centre lobby just by reception before 15:45 on Sunday 11th of October, and we will take you through to the pool and introduce everything to you. We will go through some formalities, like a 50m swim (2 lengths), and how to safely get out of the boat if you tip over. Once these are out of the way, we'll get to playing some games, an insight into what we get up to every week! If you have any questions, please drop @lancsunicanoeclub a message on Instagram or send us an email at lancasteruniversitycanoeclub@googlemail.com

events.title: Career Mentoring Session
events.description:
We invite you to come along to our Careers Workshop with
Ian Newman. Ian graduated from Lancaster University with an Economics
and Politics degree. He’s been a Career Mentor on the University’s Career
Mentoring Programme since it was launched in 2008 and, since then,  has
mentored over 200 students. In November 2023, he was awarded an Honorary Fellowship
for the extensive support he provides to the University and its students on
careers and employability. He supports around 25 students each year as part of
the Career Mentoring Programme. Ian has worked for The Stock Exchange, Royal Mail, The
Home Office, UK Border Agency and the Department for Work and Pensions. His
role at DWP was as the Deputy Head of Internal Communications, managing a team
of 70 people at a variety of locations in the UK.  He is currently the
Director for Regions for the Jaguar Enthusiasts’ Club, the largest Jaguar Club
worldwide. This careers workshop will cover the following topics: - How
     to write and tailor CVs and Cover Letters to increase your chances of
     getting to the next stage in the recruitment process - Graduate
     Programmes - Psychometric
     Tests, - Interviews
     (Competency / Behaviour / Strengths based styles of questions) Assessment
     Cen tres and what to expect

events.title: Lancaster Sail Week 2027
events.description: LUSC x ARMADA WEEK GREECE ⛵☀️ Get ready for a week of sun, sailing, island hopping and unforgettable nights as Lancaster University Sailing Club heads to Greece for Armada Week ! We’ll be setting sail from Athens and spending the week exploring the Greek islands as part of a huge flotilla of yachts. Expect crystal-clear water, secluded swimming spots, beautiful harbours and plenty of time to relax in the sun during the day, followed by organised events, bars and parties in a different destination each night. Across the week, we’ll sail between destinations including Agia Marina, Perdika, Ermioni, Dokos and Poros , stopping off at coves and anchorages along the way. There’ll be everything from beach activities and sunset drinks to raft parties, fancy dress and big nights out — all alongside other crews taking part in Armada Week. You don’t need to be an experienced sailor to come along. Each yacht has a skipper responsible for getting the boat safely between destinations, so this is as much a summer holiday and social as it is a sailing trip. Whether you’re coming for the sailing, Greek sunshine, swimming, nightlife, or just a ridiculous week away with LUSC, this is set to be one of the highlights of the year. Think Greek islands + yacht week ⛵🍻 More details on dates, travel, prices and how to secure your place will be announced by the club. Armada Week itinerary: https://www.armada-week.com/en-gb/aboutweekgreece
